dataPermissions: Every screen declares owner, source, freshness, sync behavior, and stale-data copy.
Permission checks are visible before irreversible actions.
Audit events are generated for roles, drivers, vehicles, cards, limits, and finance changes when relevant.
Sensitive information has privacy, masking, export, and retention rules.
